scripts.build:all: pnpm --filter @lsby/ai-agent run build:all && pnpm --filter @lsby/ai-memory run build:all
scripts.check:all: pnpm run check:format && pnpm run check:lint && pnpm run check:type
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @lsby/ai-agent run test && pnpm --filter @lsby/ai-memory run test
scripts.test:coverage: pnpm --filter @lsby/ai-agent run test:coverage && pnpm --filter @lsby/ai-memory run test:coverage
scripts.verify:release: pnpm run check:all && pnpm run test:coverage && pnpm run build:all
